units.source_text: 河对岸，在上车道的下面，有块专供游人散步的地方。

en.t: On the far side of the river, below the upper roadway, there was a place set aside for visitors to stroll.

units.source_text: 透过稀稀疏疏的樱树，可以看见后面正中的爱宕山，它与西山相连。

en.t: Through the sparse cherry trees, Mount Atago could be seen directly behind them, connected to the western hills.
Upstream, the river came close to the northern hills.
This whole area was a scenic district.
